text:
jo: Quick sync from todays roadmap huddle — focusing on private deployments: packaging, upgrade orchestration, and customer-managed networking. Need clear MVP vs. stretch split.

mia: From field: customers want deterministic outbound behavior + non-disruptive upgrades. Key ask: ability to pin an upgrade window and an automatic rollback if health checks fail.

carlos: Tech note: packaging options we can support at launch: (A) signed operator bundle for online installs, (B) downloadable airgap bundle (tgz) with checksum + signature, (C) small bootstrap installer for zero-touch. We should require signed bundles to pass security review.

lina: Upgrade orchestration UX: admin should pick a "maintenance window" or manual apply. During upgrades we must preserve tenant network bindings and not remap egress IPs. If a node fails, we do canary per-tenant rollback.

frank: Networking: propose "static egress binding" (map tenant to IP/pool) + optional relay proxy for NATed sites. For security-conscious customers, document how to run in pure SNAT mode (no relay) and what ports need opening.

build-bot: CI: package-sign step passing. bundle-2026-03-20-9 published to staging. smoke: 23/23. integration: 14/16. failing: upgrade smoke test where post-upgrade KMS handshake sometimes times out.

jo: Important constraints: KMS BYOK flows must not expose keys to our control plane. For MVP support: on-prem KMS connectors limited to single-region, single-key per-tenant model. Anything fancier is v2.

mia: Rollout plan: 1) internal dogfooding with canary upgrades; 2) invited pilot installs (3 customers); 3) GA. Gates: signed bundle + upgrade e2e (no data loss) + rollback tested.

carlos: Ops playbook items: scripted preflight (example):
```
redwoodctl preflight --target 10.0.2.5 --check-ports 443,80,22 --check-egress 1.2.3.4
```
Preflight must return clear actionable errors (e.g., "ALLOW outbound 1.2.3.4:443 from installer host").

lina: Console should show upgrade status by tenant and allow pause/resume during canary. Also flag any network drift (egress IP changed) as a blocker.

frank: For non-disruptive upgrades we need: bundle layering (migration scripts), migration dry-run mode, and a hook for customers to run custom checks post-upgrade. Add a --dry-run flag to installer.

jo: Prioritization suggestion: MVP-0 = signed bundles, airgap download, preflight + clear errors, upgrade window + rollback, static egress binding, BYOK basic. Stretch: dynamic peering, multi-key BYOK, tenant-level proxy, BGP.

mia: Action items: carlos -> finalize bundle signing spec + checksum strategy by Fri; lina -> console mock for upgrade canvas + network drift warnings by Wed; frank -> write preflight error templates + dry-run flag PR by Thu; jo -> customer comms + pilot onboarding checklist by Mon.

carlos: FYI: security wants attestation for airgap bundles (signed and linked to a release manifest). We'll draft the manifest format in the spec.

jo: Ok will capture and add to private-deploy roadmap doc. tagging owners. :shipit:
